findings.title: Default gap may override local Gap style
findings.message: In stacked mode the styler sets IconSize and Gap unconditionally, overriding local Style.Gap or other styles applied earlier, depending on styler ordering. The docs claim local Gap/Padding overrides remain effective, but this Styler is installed after earlier stylers and may win over the node's Gap.
findings.suggestion: Install this styler before the node-style styler, or only set Gap when the local style has no Gap.

findings.title: Spacer removal depends on private native plan item name
findings.message: The "space" spacer is also inserted by the native Button for non-icon cases; deleting by name is fragile. More importantly, FinalMaker only runs on Update; if IconPlacement changes the widget's Update is triggered via syncControl, but Styler direction/IconSize are set on the button for text-only buttons too. Deleting the space relies on the pinned Cogent version's internals, and a future upgrade silently breaks stacked layout.
findings.suggestion: Add a test pinning that the native spacer name is "space" (the test covers symbol path) and document the dependency; alternatively guard with a version-check test.
findings.evidence: p.Children = slices.DeleteFunc(p.Children, func(item *tree.PlanItem) bool { return item.Name == "space" })
